goal: Inspect an existing vendor bill in the ccMonet demo company
constraints: Demo company only. Read only: search, filter, pagination and opening or closing details are allowed; do not edit, approve, pay or delete records.

milestones.goal: Open the Vendor Bills list and observe existing rows
success_criteria: Vendor Bills table is visible with at least one existing bill

milestones.goal: Open an existing vendor bill and inspect its vendor, identifier, currency, total and status
success_criteria: An existing bill detail is open and the requested fields are visible
guidance: Bill details open in an editable modal. Opening without edits does not change the record or require saving.
